door_left.description: Open the left door (radians about its front-pillar hinge pin 400)

door_right.description: Open the right door (radians about its front-pillar hinge pin 438)

notes: Source: data/models-annotated/42083-1.mpd (Philippe Hurbain [Philo], CCAL 2.0), section '42083 - chiron.ldr', unmodified. Standalone extract written by scripts/extract_subsystem.py --section in the same frame (LDU, -Y up, front -Z, car's left +X); motion authored on source IDs and remapped (source/idmap.json).
Ratios, signs, pivots and link lengths are measured from library connector frames by scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py; embedded DATs use their library part's frames for analysis only.
Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.

Doors swing on their measured front-pillar pins; each side mirror (liftarm, axle pin and fairing on the door's long pin) swings with its door. Opening limit chosen from a separate clearance-context study that adds the surrounding bodywork (clearance-context/clearance.json).

door_left.label: Left door on its pillar hinge
notes: Hinge pin 400 at [300.0, -70.0, -300.0], axis +Y; opening sign +1; side mirror 536/537/538 hangs on the door's long pin and swings with it
door_left.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

door_right.label: Right door on its pillar hinge
notes: Hinge pin 438 at [-300.0, -70.0, -300.0], axis +Y; opening sign -1; side mirror 548/549/547 hangs on the door's long pin and swings with it
door_right.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

mounting_frame.label: Mounting frame and context (static)
mounting_frame.review: Static by decision: supports, bearings, latches and context parts selected around the moving mechanism (keep.json). The rest of the car is absent from this extract.
